caption: The drawing features three views of an object, all composed within a rectangular section on a larger, plain background. The objects are oval-shaped, shown from three perspectives: front, side, and back. The largest rendering is the front view, displaying an oval form with an intricate central pattern of interwoven curves in grayish-brown, surrounded by a ring of alternating light and dark vertical segments, and bordered by a gold-colored edge. The side view, to the right, shows the thickness of the object, revealing layered bands in gold and brown with a pin or fastening mechanism protruding outward. Below these two is a smaller depiction that appears to be a miniature or rear version of the object, sharing the same general color scheme: brown, gold, and touches of black. The surrounding background is off-white, and subtle brown discoloration marks are present on both the main and embedded rectangle surfaces. At the bottom of the page, the text “Westchester County” appears on the lower left and “Drawn by Wm P. Shearwood” on the lower right.
title: Hair Brooch and Ring
